sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro Model Card (June 27, 2025)
sources.evidence: Exact Pro card covers GA, Experimental 03-25 and Preview 05-06 separately. It identifies sparse MoE Transformers and API evaluation, without numerical total or active parameter counts.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro — Gemini API
sources.evidence: Exact stable ID gemini-2.5-pro: 1,048,576 input tokens, 65,536 output tokens; audio, image, video, text and PDF inputs; text output; thinking and function calling supported. September 22, 2026 documentation retains access for previous users; no endpoint was tested.

sources.title: Gemini API release notes
sources.evidence: Dates the 03-25 experimental release to March 25, the 06-05 preview to June 5, and stable gemini-2.5-pro to June 17, 2025. It separately records subsequent redirects of older preview IDs.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5: Updates to our family of thinking models
sources.evidence: June 17, 2025 GA announcement explicitly states there are no changes from the 06-05 Pro preview, providing an exact underlying-model identity bridge.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Proprietary service terms govern access and prohibit extraction of underlying model components, including parameter weights; the page does not offer an open-weight model license.

sources.title: Gemini 2.5 technical report
sources.evidence: Section 2.1 specifies sparse MoE Transformers. Table 2 explicitly maps Gemini 2.5 Pro to gemini-2.5-pro. The training sections and model-comparison tables disclose no numerical total or active count; Table 1 audio-output entries are qualified experimental/preview variants.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Pro Model Card (May 2026 revision)
sources.evidence: Later card and visually inspected comparison table on PDF page 5 include a Gemini 2.5 Pro column with capability results, but no retrospective parameter counts.

sources.title: Gemini 3 Flash Model Card (December 2025)
sources.evidence: Later card and visually inspected comparison table on PDF page 4 include the exact Gemini 2.5 Pro Thinking column; no total or active parameter count appears.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon Model Card (October 2026)
sources.evidence: Latest-generation first-party architecture and evaluation sections checked for retrospective disclosures; no Gemini 2.5 Pro parameter counts are supplied.

sources.title: Models.dev Gemini 2.5 Pro record
sources.evidence: Baseline source followed and raw record retrieved. Its June 17 date describes the stable endpoint launch; technical fields were independently checked against Google sources.

developer.note: Google publishes the model; development is attributed to Google DeepMind and the Gemini Team.

family.note: Retain the catalog’s normalized Pro subfamily key within the official Gemini 2.5 family.

release_date.note: Earliest public release of the underlying GA model: June 5 preview. Stable ID launched June 17 with explicitly no model changes. March 25 was an earlier distinct experimental revision; later redirects do not establish earlier checkpoint identity.

open_weights.note: Hosted proprietary model distribution; no public checkpoint or open-weight license in the reviewed official release/model documentation.

license.note: Descriptive model/service classification. Documentation and sample-code licenses do not apply to model weights.

parameters_b.note: No numerical total count in the exact card, training report or checked later cards and exact-model comparison columns. Targeted first-party training/interpretability searches did not locate a count; no estimate is substituted.

active_parameters_b.note: Sparse per-token expert activation is documented, but its numerical active count is not disclosed in the checked sources. It is not equated with total size.

architecture.note: Explicit sparse mixture-of-experts Transformer. The report’s Table 2 connects the described Pro model to this exact stable API ID.

context_window.note: Documented input-token limit; 65,536 output tokens is a separate limit, not an addition to this catalog value.

modalities.note: Use the exact stable endpoint specification. The report’s qualified audio-generation variants do not establish audio output for this ID.

reasoning.note: Thinking supported; adaptive thinking is explicitly documented for the 06-05 and stable model.

tool_call.note: Exact endpoint lists function calling; the report independently identifies tool use.

description.value: Google’s multimodal reasoning model with adaptive thinking, function calling, and support for coding, mathematics, and document analysis.
description.note: Replace the subjective baseline word proven with documented capabilities.

patch.description: Google’s multimodal reasoning model with adaptive thinking, function calling, and support for coding, mathematics, and document analysis.

Gemini API Additional Terms of Service

patch.notes: The GA model first appeared as gemini-2.5-pro-preview-06-05 on June 5, 2025; the stable gemini-2.5-pro ID launched June 17 with no changes, per Google. March 25 and May 6 were earlier revisions. Sparse MoE Transformer; total and active parameter counts are undisclosed. Context is the documented 1,048,576-token input limit; output limit is separate. API documentation was checked, not live endpoint operation.

summary: Audited all 14 fields. Correct release date to June 5 using Google’s explicit preview-to-GA identity bridge; add sparse MoE architecture, proprietary licensing, primary provenance and a factual description. Confirm exact endpoint modalities, input limit, reasoning and tool calling. Total/active parameters remain undisclosed after exact-card, training-report, later exact-model comparison-table and targeted first-party interpretability checks.
